validation.tuned_baseline: Staged thresholds: heat high <19.5 C, low <20.5 C, cool >24 C, high >25 C; ventilation 1/2/3 above 800/1000/1300 ppm; purifier 1/2/3 above 12/20/35 ug/m3; humidity 40-60%; clean above 15% dirt. Same shared rules.
validation.baseline: HVAC heat below 20 C, cool above 24 C; ventilation above 1000 ppm CO2; purifier above 12 ug/m3 PM2.5; humidity target 40-60%; clean above 30% dirt. Shared lighting, blinds, security, sleep and final safety rules.
validation.method: Paired closed-loop simulation: identical initial states, weather, seeded physics/occupancy noise; 10-minute steps. Both controllers use the same final safety rules. No training.
